Mindset eXchangeNYE noter til Mindset eXchange (The Book of Mindsets og MindPool) Opdateret den 27. oktober 2020
Mindset eXchangeThe overall conceptA personal “textbook”Different subjects/interestsPurpose fulfilledThe Book of MindsetsMindPoolCredits earned … to become smarter?The motivationThe fact-finding The how to …The result … and then? The WHATThe WHY

What if we want to achieve? Ultimately to make people “smarter”, i.e. aware of …; capable of debating and understanding …; adjusting to …; basically defined as getting a new mindset and/or a new way of thinking [about …]? What are the “…” representing? Obviously: multiple purposes, but essentially a wish or need to personalize learning and knowledge, and to reward time spent acquiring new skills with a bonus of “credits/tokens” to be used for […]? If so, how can we do this in practical terms – for instance: How do different individuals demonstrate chosen new “skills”? Will “the market” accept this approach as par to the existing recruitment and evaluation systems? Will the existing educational system be prepared or accept such a “disruption”? Will Artificials (as mentors/teachers) in reality be able to substitute our present ways? Answering these questions reflects back to MindFuture Foundation’s overall purpose: Creating and provoking a debate is the prime target (hence the vision of an art/techno approach to AI/AM). Creating and positioning AM’s (v AI’s) is the tool to do this, and following to bring attention to the 18th Global Goal and create a global consensus of responsible use of AI-technologies, and eventually to produce and actually present real artificial thinking machines. Doing this is taking on the present debate and development of the hyped concept of AI (NLP, ML, NN, ANI, AGI, ASI etc. – i.e. ranging from banal chatbots developing into the next generation companions and on). In terms of “making people smarter” and both able and prepared  to engage in this debate, we’ve contemplated “The Book of Mindsets”, fundamentally to speed up the process of information and facts about what’s going on. Collecting data to a MindPool may not be the hard part, but validating and keeping them up to date can be? Creating an AM-persona to sort out and customize the data to a personal level may not be hard either, but it will require a point of origin and a destination point. Are we in essence “just” facilitators, or do we risk ending up as a medium/educators? If so, what will we call ourselves: disruptors or prophets; philosophers or futurists, or any other branding? We will need to figure out both the what and the why, and be able to explain this in an “elevator pitch style”.

Format: The newsletters Hello Humans are max. 1.000 - 2.000 words including images and link, where the link gets a generic headline. In the column format (layout of HH) this corresponds to 4-5-6 pages, where a normal A4 page is usually about 1.000 words. There is no reference to columns, as they will get their own life via a blog. I have developed a layout format for our own columns/comments — but contributors can deliver whatever they want in their own chosen formats (also video, audio, etc.).Content strategy: I am attaching a description with keywords for the upcoming HH, where you are very welcome to supplement with keywords & phrases that could be relevant to the content — just write to me — and if there are topics for additional newsletters, please also bring those […]. Timing and flow: We have written 2 newsletters — the introduction of HH/AM style and the one about “the masks”. We have not yet published them, and the latter has a need for topicality. We discussed launch for mid-January 2021, but I have started to doubt whether we can wait that long. Maybe we should consider an earlier launch — e.g. mid/end November 2020 for HH1? On that occasion, I think we could also consider spinning off The Book of Mindset as a separate “activity” (like the 18th site) among other things to get a quicker lead-in and a flow? I have started writing on new HH3: “I’m glad you asked”. I chose this as a start because it gives a flow, setting the tone and format. We could possibly also consider that this is HH2, and that “the masks” then become HH3? The flow would then be e.g. HH1 mid-November 2020, HH 2 end of November — and HH3 (the masks and Covid) early/mid December, to keep topicality? Columns: I have rewritten the columns on Masquerade and The Mask Game — and use some of the material in new HH3 “I’m glad you asked”, because it thereby also becomes an explanation of/to understand the premises of the debate with AM’s — including that we are not/will not be a classic medium, and/or a new SoMe debate forum (cf. format considerations).Progress: The point is thus to introduce Mind Exchange, Mindpool and the blog — and thereby the concept The Book of Mindsets — which thus can be started with a real AM/GPT-3 dialogue between participants in the debate and MindFuture Foundation. It naturally must be linked to the 18th Global Goal.The point is also that the primary purpose of MindFuture is the 18th global goal, where stakeholders through kickstarter and strong sponsors    can contribute to the political debate to get the UN to “buy into the 18th” and take ownership.The point further is to fund artworks and projects that move the debate into physical space, including e.g. Davos and COP, as originally planned. And finally, the ultimate goal is that AM’s manifest themselves in a product and/or a function which we humans will have to live with [sic]. 2 of 2
